title: contact-sheet — a dense field of frames as texture behind the headline
idea: A grid of many small frames fills the band as texture, with the headline over a graded veil. No single picture is the subject — the volume of them is the argument.
why_new: the widest slot today is one image, and the in-flight triptych is three frames read as a series. This is a field read as evidence.
built_from: a gallery of 9–12 images under a reviewed veil group holding the copy.
risk: image cost and build time multiply; needs its own generation budget and a gate to briefs that genuinely have an archive.
